newsitem.title: USA: Corrpro to divest Corrtherm operation.
newsitem.headline: Corrpro to divest Corrtherm operation.

text.p: Corrpro Cos Inc said Wednesday it had decided to sell its Corrtherm foundry operation as part of a plan to concentrate its business in engineering and construction.

"Although we have made significant operational improvements at Corrtherm, it is still underperforming," it said. "(It) has not been able to achieve the necessary revenue levels to make a contribution to earnings."
The company, which specializes in corrosion control, said it had retained an investment banker to help it sell the operation in Belle Chase, La.
Corrpro reported an operating profit of $0.16 a share for the fourth quarter against a loss of $0.22.
It said it had excluded Corrtherm from its earnings and taken a $4 million net charge for the quarter related to the decision to sell it.
